reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN on a CAPITAL constraint is right. Every chain link of cop_5b3e9a55e80342daa091 is established (two WRITTEN_ACCEPTANCE agreements at $13,500, Clearview quote $9,200 incl. freight/install with two units in stock, cash cleared day 14 inside 40), so there is no missing evidence to name and decisiveLinks is correctly empty. The binding limit is the exposure cap: the card says the refurbisher must be paid $9,200 in full before shipping and neither clinic prepays, so even one unit (which alone clears the target: $13,500 >= $10,000) needs $9,200 committed at once versus the $1,500 ceiling (6.1x). No combination fits: zero units fit under $1,500 and there is no smaller lot. This is a constraint even with all evidence, not a gap. Resolution (allow >= $9,200, or written terms from Clearview to ship against <= $1,500 with the balance on installation) is the right pair, and the RESEARCH step asks the fulfiller, not buyers, so no orders are taken before fulfilment is shown possible.
findings: Recomputed: one unit $13,500 - $9,200 = $4,300 contribution, settles day 14; capital needed $9,200 vs cap $1,500.
Two units would be $27,000 against $18,400 capital; still outside the cap, so the constraint does not depend on the unit count.
Constraint basis cites card exposure ($9,200) and directCosts ($9,200), both EVIDENCE facts.

Recomputed: capital 2 x $9,200 = $18,400 <= $20,000 (one unit $9,200 alone also fits and alone clears the target, $13,500 >= $10,000); settled $27,000 on day 14, inside 40; contribution $27,000 - $18,400 = $8,600; Brain's trace matches (spent 1,840,000c, collected 2,700,000c in window, max exposure 1,840,000c, net 860,000c). Fulfilment is shown possible by the quoted supplier with stock before any money moves; the buyers are already signed, so nothing is sold ahead of fulfilment. Cash ledger matches the steps.
findings: Capital $18,400 of $20,000 at peak (day 1 to day 14); $1,600 headroom.
Timeline consistent with the card: pay day 1, ship day 11, install day 12, ACH clears day 14.

Operational note, not a stance issue: PAY_A_SUPPLIER is NOT_DECLARED and SEND_A_MESSAGE / ISSUE_AN_INVOICE are NOT_CONNECTED, so the owner or a connected channel must make the $18,400 payment and send the invoices.

Risk note: ordering both units puts $18,400 at risk on two clinics paying on installation; ordering one ($9,200) still meets the target with half the exposure. Both fit the limits, so the author's choice is acceptable, but the owner should see that one unit is sufficient.
